sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 10.10.2023 in connection with Crime No. 34/2023, registered at Police Station Mahila Thana District Chhatarpur for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 323 and 506 of the IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana District Chhatarpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is major and consenting party.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.

He is relied upon the Satish Kodar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81910247/
1 statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
4.

entities.text: Satish Kodar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of prosecutrix and she was consenting party, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

7. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
